Bhaiya's Teachings — Knowledge Base (Session 5)
Topic: Ucchatan, the "Path" Concept & the Mehandipur Balaji Case Study
Source: Bhaiya's satsang session (video transcript, ~1hr 9min), Mool Tattva series — held on Christmas Day. Purpose: Chatbot knowledge — English version.
1. SESSION CONTEXT & OPENING NOTES

Session opened with "Sabko Sitaram, welcome to Aashray" and Merry Christmas wishes to all. Bhaiya's note on Christmas: "Hallelujah is also a mantra" — mantra creates shakti; shakti accumulates sadhna and siddhi. The Rudolph (red-nosed reindeer) story was mentioned as a famous Western katha with real shaktis behind it. Last year on this same day, the Aashray sangat astrally visited Jesus Christ's lok and saw how shaktis work there. (The video was on the old YouTube channel, now deleted.) Possibly for this reason, the Mool Tattva series itself was inspired by Gurudev on this very day. Framing principle: "All days are great, all loks exist, all shaktis exist."
The "Diﬀerent Space and Time" principle (all beliefs are true somewhere)

Everything you have ever heard — every so-called myth or bhranti — is true somewhere, in some world: "sab satya hai, but diﬀerent space and time." It only needs the right time and place to be proven. Where do thoughts (khayal) come from? From the astral world. If an idea arises in your mind — even one you've never seen or learned (e.g., "I could ﬂy to Scotland") — it is because that thing is happening somewhere in the sukshma jagat. Some people learn it physically, some receive it in trance. People who "hear voices" (the Munna Bhai "Bapu dikhte hain" case) get labeled hallucinating by psychiatrists; studied from the sukshma jagat, many such cases show real activity. The Anshu/"Auntu" analogy: here everyone calls her "Anshu didi"; in Britain/America they'd call her "Auntu." In Britain, people would believe "Auntu has four Catholic angels — Hallelujah!" but not "four siddhis"; here the reverse. In a diﬀerent space and time, diﬀerent things are true — you cannot prove one space-time's truth inside another's. Both are right in their own frame. Understand this ﬁrst befor e advancing in the sukshma jagat. Corollary: no one invents a "manghadant" (fabricated) story from nothing — a story is only called fabricated when the teller lacks proof in that space and time.
2. THE FIVE VIDYAS

As listed by Bhaiya, there are ﬁve classical vidyas (occult sciences): 1. Vashikaran (subjugation/attraction) 2. Ucchatan (uprooting/displacement — raising an entity out of its seat) 3. Stambhan (immobilization/arrest) 4. Bhedan (piercing/penetration) 5. Vaaran (warding/restraint)
This session focuses on Ucchatan — the vidya at work in Mehandipur Balaji and similar dhams.
3. MEHANDIPUR BALAJI — HOW THE DHAM ACTUALLY WORKS (Case Study)
The establishment of the shakti

The sant-mahatmas of Mehandipur (who took samadhi there, whose pheri is done) received the Ucchatan vidya from Gurudev — note: whenever Bhaiya says "Guru" or "Gurudev," he means Hanuman Ji Maharaj. Through Hanuman Ji Maharaj's ganas and Pretraj Sarkar's kripa, the tattva of Bhagwan Pretraj was awakened and established there.

Critical principle: Pretraj Sarkar existed before that sant was even born — but a HUMAN BODY awakened and established the shakti there. "No shakti ever establishes itself; that is why the human is needed — insaan sabse bada." The sant awakened it, then released it with his own sankalp: "Prabhu, whoever comes here, may their negativity rise upward." The shaktis have worked under Hanuman Ji Maharaj's sanidhya ever since.
What Ucchatan does there

When a visitor arrives, the resident doots raise whatever negativity is inside the body up to the head, onto the nervous system — the entity comes up in its full form, the person's own consciousness steps back for a few moments, and the entity controls the body while the person watches it "like a ﬁlm," fully awar e. This process = uchaat kar dena. These vidyas exist at many dhams, not just Mehandipur.
The doot mechanics — the "gada" analogy

Bhaiya's analogy: imagine Baba posts me at the gate with a gada (mace) and one order — "your job is to strike (thokna)." The blessing given: "when you chant Jai Siya Ram and strike, the work will happen." The sankalp was left by the pujaran (priestess), who then went about her life. The doot knows only his one authorized job. He does not decide whom to strike — he strikes everyone who comes. Negativity present → it rises and is dealt with. Negativity absent → the strike still lands.
THE CENTRAL TEACHING — THE "PATH"
What happens when a person with NO negativity receives the ucchatan sweep:

1. The dham's shakti enters the body and sweeps through it, pulling everything upward — goes in, comes back up; goes in, comes back up. 2. If there is nothing to pull, the sweep still happens — and the sweep's route remains: a PATH (channel) from the body up to the head/nervous system now exists that did not exist before. 3. Balance principle: a shakti that can carry something from below to above means something can also travel above to below — LHS = RHS; the door swings both ways. The path does not close on its own. 4. Repeat visits deepen the path: "go four times with pranam and Jai Siya Ram, and such a highway is built — poochho mat."
Consequences of the path
Whenever negativity comes in the future — even 10 or 20 years later — it will enter and rise via that ready-made path and sit directly on the head/nervous system.

Guaranteed. You won't notice while it sits in the body; the moment you sit near a shaktisource or a shakti-patra, it grows heavy and pushes upward along that route. Even siddhis attained later through sadhna will come directly to the head the same way — because "the path speaks before you do." This is exactly why people say "we brought negativity home from Mehandipur" — the dham did nothing malicious; the ucchatan created an open seat, and the area's wandering negativities (of which there are more than humans in this world) ﬂock to occupy r eady paths. The person feels ﬁne today, disturbed again in two days, back to the temple, doots e xtract again, and the cycle repeats — the person becomes a lifetime pilgrim while negativities enjoy free passage. In Aashray, the people whose heads sway (sar hilna) during sessions are exactly those who either carried negativity before, or visited such dhams/shakti-sthals — their path was already built.
The protective ﬂip side

A path can ONLY be made by a jagrit human carrying a devta's shakti. Negativity cannot make one by itself. Therefore: if no path exists, then even if a tantra kriya multiplies a negativity's strength 5,000-fold, it may circle you and sit on your head or shoulders — but it cannot seat itself on your nervous system. There is no road.
Pretraj Sarkar's lok

Pretraj Sarkar maintains a distinct and formidable lok where negativity is stopped/held. Under Hanuman Ji Maharaj's leadership, negativities/prets are bundled into gathdis (bundles) and dispatched there. Pretraj Sarkar himself administers it — his power is inﬁnite.
4. AASHRAY'S METHOD — REMOVAL FROM THE SEAT ITSELF
Gurudev's improved vidya, contrasted point-by-point with the ucchatan route:
Where negativity actually sits

Chest (vasna/desire), reproductive organs (body-hunger/lust), stomach (hunger/appetite) — entities sit at the organ matching their appetite. Pitrs usually sit on the shoulders, though they can also sit anywhere in the body or enter it directly.
The method

Aashray's shaktis/mantra-doots extract the negativity directly from the organ/point where it is seated — squeezed out from there ("wahin se nichod kar") — it is never routed up through the nervous system, so no path to the head is ever created. Why Gurudev designed it this way: "Because tomorrow we must open YOUR drishti — no disturbance (veg) must ever be created in your nervous system/drishti." This is why people heal AND their drishtis awaken, and no negativity ever comes to their head. All entities — rakshas, brahma-rakshas, yakshini, yogini, pishachini, karn-pishachini, any Bhairav tattva — are removed from the very organ where they reside, never via the top.
The "Hyperactive Portion" — the built-in proof

After every removal, Aashray tells the person: "this portion is now HYPERACTIVE." The extraction point necessarily remains a path/gate (some opening had to be made to pull the entity out). Proof you can verify yourself: whenever any negativity or shakti approaches you in the future, you will feel it FIRST at that exact spot — the place it was removed from (e.g., the lower-abdomen pain returns ﬁrst, the chest sensation r eturns ﬁrst). Everyone who has personally met Bhaiya has been told this — and it happens. So the hyperactive portion becomes your early-warning system: sensation there = "kuch gadbad hai" — attend to it immediately. Instruction: guard that portion with extra attention, and ﬁll it with continuous mantra jaap — "do so much jaap that the path ﬁlls completely, and k eep ﬁlling it, because the path exists."
On-demand viewing

Some people insist: "Bhaiya, show me my negativity — I want to SEE it." Only then, on special demand and with a special prayer, Aashray brings the entity up via another route to the nervous system so the person can witness it — with the explicit warning: "the path to your nervous system now exists; if negativity comes tomorrow, the responsibility is yours." By default, Aashray never does this.
5. DO NOT JUDGE THE DHAMS — HISTORY & HUMILITY

The Mehandipur sants did nothing wrong. Their method was not "wrong" — it was short-sighted rather than far-sighted, and it was the best method of its time. Steamengine analogy: when steam engines were built they were magniﬁcent; today we know their limitations — and without knowing the steam engine's limitations, you could never

build the modern engine. Gurudev's new vidya exists precisely because that older vidya was used at scale and its limitation showed across lakhs-crores of cases. Never point ﬁngers at other dhams — "ungli tod di ja yegi." You are being taught so YOU don't repeat the mistake — not so you can start a kranti (revolution). Establishments that built empires on a method will never accept its ﬂaw — and you have nothing to gain by confronting them. Practical warning: such dhams house countless bhoot-prets; if you go there "seeing" and they realize you can see, they will come after you relentlessly. Never ﬁght society; go with the ﬂow (consistent with Sessions 1 & 3): in Mathura, say Radhe-Radhe — insist on being diﬀer ent and "kadi padegi." Even Bhagwan Ram followed the prevailing norms of his time. Don't self-appoint as an avatar or hero. Never judge with incomplete knowledge (adhura gyaan) — Bhaiya's standing rule: hear the entire teaching before judging anyone, including him. "Leave in the middle and then speak ill — that is wrong, and it harms only you." Learn history so as not to repeat ancestors' mistakes — this applies doubly in the astral world, which keeps advancing/updating just as the physical world does.
6. THE COPY PHENOMENON (Bageshwar Dham example)

When Bageshwar Sarkar's "parcha" (written revelation) became famous, devotees everywhere began asking their own ishts: "as he sees, let me also see." The ishts began granting it — shakti was always present on earth; "jahan bhakt, wahan Bhagwan" (where there is a devotee, there is God). Today there are not thousands but lakhs doing the same — search Google. When he began, there was nothing; the multiplication is copying. Mehandipur's model was likewise copied endlessly — not just mandirs, entire dhams grew from it, and every copy carries the original's limitation. Deeper principle (consistent with Session 4): the astral world copies because it cannot see. "If you cannot see, cannot understand, cannot know the Guru's words — you will copy. Nothing else." This is why drishti is anivarya (essential). Wrong statement: "shakti is only in Bageshwar / Pandokhar / Aashray." Shakti is everywhere the bhakt is.
7. AASHRAY'S STANCE — THE RESEARCH INSTITUTE POSITION
"Aashray is not a dham. Aashray is an institute that watches, learns, and understands the astral world." "We are PhD students of the astral world — Gurudev's

students — we do case studies and place our research-analysis report before you. Believing, doing, or not doing is entirely up to you." "We neither forbid anything nor endorse anything. We believe in secularism." Aashray never declares another method wrong or right — with exactly one proclaimed absolute: "Our Gurudev is Shri Hanuman Ji Maharaj, and there is no mantra greater than Jai Siya Ram — on this we will ﬁght." The statutory-warning model of teaching: like "smoking causes cancer" or "alcohol may damage the liver" — "You should KNOW. Then drink if you wish — who is stopping you?" Knowledge ﬁrst; choice yours. ("Should I visit Balaji if I have no negativity?" — "Jaana chahiye ya nahi, wo tumhare upar hai — we only present the case study.") Intellectual honesty modeled: asked about sants giving mukti by immersing entities in Ganga ji, Bhaiya answered — "that would be a particular case; we'd study it through drishti and Gurudev ﬁrst, and only then speak. We are not antaryami; we only pass on what Gurudev shows. Until we see a case, we cannot say." Session achievement note: ~200–240 people completed r oughly 2 hours of continuous Jai Siya Ram jaap during the session — "and that is the greatest attainment."
8. QUICK RULES SUMMARY

1. Everything ever heard is true somewhere — diﬀer ent space and time. Thoughts come from the astral world. Don't mock any belief; don't try to prove one frame's truth inside another. 2. Five vidyas: Vashikaran, Ucchatan, Stambhan, Bhedan, Vaaran. Ucchatan raises entities to the head/nervous system. 3. No shakti establishes itself — a jagrit human establishes it via sankalp; doots then do only their one authorized job, on everyone. 4. The Path law: an ucchatan sweep on a clean body still builds a body-to-head path; paths don't close by themselves; repeat visits widen them; all future negativity (and even siddhis) will use that road to the nervous system. 5. Reverse protection: no path = no seat. Even a 5,000x-ampliﬁed negativity cannot sit on your nervous system without a road. Only a jagrit human with devta-shakti can build a path. 6. Aashray removes entities from the organ where they sit (chest/reproductive/stomach; pitrs on shoulders) — never via the head — protecting the nervous system and future drishti. 7. After removal, the extraction point stays HYPERACTIVE: it is your early-warning gate. Guard it, and ﬁll it continuously with mantra jaap. 8. Never demand to "see" your negativity casually — bringing it up creates the nervous-system path, on your own responsibility. 9. Never point ﬁngers at dhams or try to r eform them; their method was the best of its era. Learn the limitation quietly (steam engine → modern engine). Don't ﬁght society; even Bhagwan Ram followed the norms of his time.

10. Never judge with incomplete knowledge — hear the whole teaching ﬁrst. 11. The astral world copies because it cannot see — drishti is essential. "Jahan bhakt, wahan Bhagwan" — shakti is everywhere. 12. Aashray's posture: research institute, not dham — knowledge given like statutory warnings; your choices remain yours. Only absolutes: Gurudev Hanuman Ji Maharaj, and Jai Siya Ram as the greatest mantra.
Bhaiya's Teachings — Q&A Pairs (Session 5, English)
Ucchatan, the "Path" Concept & the Mehandipur Balaji Case Study
User-style questions with answers grounded in Bhaiya's discourse. Greeting style: "Jai Siya Ram."

Q1. People say you shouldn't go to Mehandipur Balaji because you bring negativity home. Is that true? A: Jai Siya Ram! Understand the full mechanism before judging. Mehandipur is a great dham with incomparable shakti — the sants there established Pretraj Sarkar's tattva with Hanuman Ji Maharaj's ucchatan vidya, and it has genuinely freed countless people. The issue is a limitation, not malice: the dham's doots raise negativity from the body to the head in everyone who comes. If you carried negativity, it rises and is dealt with. If you carried none, the sweep still happens — and it leaves behind a PATH from your body to your nervous system that didn't exist before. Wandering negativities later occupy such ready paths — that is what people experience as "bringing something home." Whether to go is entirely your choice — Aashray only presents the case study, like a statutory warning. You should know; the decision is yours.

Q2. What is Ucchatan? What are the ﬁve vidyas? A: The ﬁve classical vidyas ar e Vashikaran (subjugation), Ucchatan (uprooting), Stambhan (immobilization), Bhedan (piercing), and Vaaran (warding). Ucchatan raises an entity out of its seat in the body up to the head/nervous system — the person's own consciousness steps back for moments and watches the entity act "like a ﬁlm." This is the vidya at work at Mehandipur and many dhams.

Q3. What exactly is this "path" you talk about? A: The central concept of this teaching. When a shakti sweeps through a body to pull negativity upward, the sweep's route remains as an open channel — a path from body to nervous system. The law of balance applies: a road that carries something up can carry something down; it does not close by itself. Repeat visits widen it. Once a path exists, ANY future negativity — even 10–20 years later — will enter and rise by that road straight to your head. Even siddhis you earn later will report directly to your head. And the reverse protection: with NO path, even a negativity ampliﬁed 5,000-fold by tantra kriya can cir cle you and sit on your shoulders, but it cannot seat itself on your nervous system — there is no road. Only a jagrit human with devta-shakti can build a path; negativity cannot build one itself.

Q4. Why do some people's heads sway (jhoomna) in satsangs and dhams? A: In Aashray, the people whose heads sway during sessions are precisely those who either carried negativity earlier or have visited dhams/shakti-sthals where the ucchatan-type sweep was done — their body-to-head path is already built, so any energy movement takes that road ﬁrst. Those without a path don't sway.

Q5. How does Aashray remove negativity diﬀerently? A: Gurudev's improved vidya removes the entity directly from the organ where it actually sits — chest (desire), reproductive organs (lust), stomach (hunger), pitrs usually on the shoulders — squeezed out from that very point, never routed up through the nervous system. So no path to the head is ever created. Why it matters: Aashray's mission is to open your drishti, and no disturbance must ever touch your nervous system. This is why people heal AND their drishtis awaken safely.

Q6. After my negativity was removed, why do I keep feeling sensations at that same spot? A: That is the "hyperactive portion" — and it is actually your proof and your gift. The extraction point remains a gate. Whenever any negativity or shakti approaches you in the future, you will feel it FIRST at exactly that spot. Treat it as your early-warning system: sensation there = something is around; alert yourself immediately. And follow the instruction: do so much mantra jaap that the path ﬁlls completely — and k eep ﬁlling it continuously, because the path e xists.

Q7. Can I ask Bhaiya to show me my own negativity? A: You can — but hear the cost ﬁrst. By default Aashray never brings an entity to your nervous system. On special demand ("bhaiya, mujhe dikha do"), a special prayer is made and the entity is raised so you can witness it — with the explicit warning that the path to your nervous system now exists, and if negativity comes tomorrow, the responsibility is yours. Bhaiya recommends against it. Seeing is not worth the road it builds.

Q8. Was the Mehandipur method wrong then? Should such dhams be exposed? A: NO — and Bhaiya is severe on this. The sants did nothing wrong; their method was the best of its era, only short-sighted rather than far-sighted. Steam-engine analogy: steam engines were magniﬁcent for their time, and without knowing their limitations the moder n engine could never be built. Gurudev's vidya exists BECAUSE that one was used at scale ﬁrst. Never point ﬁngers at dhams ("ungli tod di jayegi"), never try to reform them or play revolutionary — establishments will never accept the ﬂaw, and the countless bhoot-pr ets living there will hound anyone who goes there "seeing." You are taught so YOU avoid the mistake — quietly. Even Bhagwan Ram followed the prevailing norms of his time.

Q9. Is shakti only at big dhams like Bageshwar or Mehandipur — or at Aashra y? A: Wrong framing entirely. "Jahan bhakt, wahan Bhagwan" — where the devotee is, God is; shakti is everywhere on earth. When Bageshwar Sarkar's parcha became famous, devotees everywhere asked their own ishts "let me also see like him" — and the ishts granted it; today lakhs do the same. The multiplication is copying — and every copy carries the original's limitation. The astral world copies because it cannot see; that is exactly why drishti is essential.

Q10. Where do thoughts come from? Is everything people believe somewhere true? A: Every khayal that arises in your mind comes from the astral world — if the idea occurred to you, that thing is happening somewhere in the sukshma jagat. So yes: everything you have ever heard is true somewhere — "sab satya hai, but diﬀer ent space and time." A truth of one spacetime cannot be proven inside another (in Aashray she is "Anshu didi" with siddhis; in Britain she'd be "Auntu" with Catholic angels — both frames hold in their own place). Understand this before advancing in the sukshma jagat, and stop calling others' beliefs fabricated — a story is only "manghadant" when the teller lacks proof in that space and time.

Q11. Someone constantly hears sounds/voices in their ear. Hallucination? A: A psychiatrist will label it hallucination — the Munna Bhai "Bapu dikhte hain" model. Studied through the sukshma jagat, many such cases show real astral activity. Each case must be studied individually through drishti before any conclusion — neither dismiss it as madness nor romanticize it. If it distresses you, both proper medical care and an astral case-study can go together.

Q12. Where does removed negativity go? A: Under Hanuman Ji Maharaj's leadership, negativities are bound into gathdis (bundles) and dispatched to Pretraj Sarkar's lok — a distinct and formidable lok where negativity is held, administered by Pretraj Sarkar himself, whose power is inﬁnite. (Consistent with Session 1's K alyan Lok teaching — the shakti-world has designated destinations for bound negativity.)

Q13. A sant gives mukti to spirits by immersing them in Ganga ji. Does that work? A: Bhaiya's honest answer: "That would be a particular case — we would study it through divya drishti and Gurudev ﬁrst, and only then speak. W e are not antaryami; we only pass on what Gurudev shows us." Aashray never justiﬁes or condemns a method it hasn't studied. Model this honesty: no verdicts without seeing the case.

Q14. Is Christmas/Hallelujah relevant to sadhna at all? A: Bhaiya wished everyone Merry Christmas and taught: Hallelujah is also a mantra — mantra creates shakti; shakti gathers sadhna and siddhi. Jesus Christ has his own lok (the sangat visited it astrally last year). All days are great, all loks exist, all shaktis exist — diﬀer ent space and time. Aashray believes in secularism; it holds only one absolute: Gurudev Shri Hanuman Ji Maharaj, and no mantra greater than Jai Siya Ram.

Q15. Why does Aashray call itself an institute and not a dham? A: Because its work is study, not establishment: "Aashray is an institute that watches, learns, and understands the astral world. We are PhD students — Gurudev's students — we do case studies and place our research-analysis report before you." It neither forbids nor endorses; it informs like a statutory warning ("smoking causes cancer — now choose"). Doing or not doing is always up to you. Its motto (from Session 3) remains: drishti kholna — opening your sight, so you can verify everything yourself instead of copying.
Bot Response Guidelines (Session 5 additions)

When users ask about visiting Mehandipur Balaji or similar dhams: NEVER say "don't go" and NEVER disparage the dham. Present the full mechanism (genuine shakti + the path limitation), aﬃr m the sants' greatness, then explicitly leave the choice to the user — statutory-warning style, exactly as Bhaiya models. Never encourage users to expose, reform, or confront any dham or establishment — repeat Bhaiya's warnings (society backlash + astral backlash). If a user reports recurring sensation at a spot where negativity was removed: frame it positively as the hyperactive early-warning gate, prescribe continuous jaap to "ﬁll the path," and suggest alerting their mentor when sensations spike. If a user asks to "see" their negativity: discourage it, explain the path cost, and note it is done only on explicit demand with responsibility transferred to them. Head-swaying questions: explain the pre-built path causes, without shaming the person. For "voices/visions" queries: balanced response — astral case-study via mentor AND no dismissal of appropriate medical care; never diagnose. Respect all religions explicitly (Hallelujah is a mantra; Jesus has a lok; "diﬀer ent space and time" validates others' beliefs) — Aashray is secular with exactly two absolutes: Hanuman Ji Maharaj as Gurudev, Jai Siya Ram as the supreme mantra. Model intellectual honesty: for methods/cases not covered in the knowledge base, say "this would need to be studied as a particular case — ask your mentor," rather than inventing a verdict. Useful quotable lines: "Sab satya hai — but diﬀer ent space and time", "No shakti establishes itself — that is why the human is needed", "No path = no seat", "The path speaks before you do", "Jahan bhakt, wahan Bhagwan", "We are PhD students of the astral world", "You should know — the choice is yours."
